The first release of WoW Foreverywhere: World of Warcraft: Forever on Snapdragon Android handhelds without a PC.

## What's included

- **In-app game installer.** Downloads the WoW Forever client from Blizzard's CDN to internal storage or an SD card, with pause, resume, repair and background downloading.
- **Uses the copy you already have.** Finds existing installs on internal storage and SD cards, including ones copied from a PC.
- **Beta and launch versions.** Runs the WoW Forever beta today and the launch version from 4 November, with a switch that reuses your game data.
- **Addon manager.** Browse, search, install, update and remove addons by category from WoWInterface and a curated GitHub catalog (Questie, Deadly Boss Mods, BigWigs, Plater, Dominos, Bartender4 and more), with Forever and Classic builds marked clearly.
- **Saved login.** Optional Battle.net auto-login, sealed with the Android Keystore and handed to the game for a few seconds only.
- **New launcher.** Controller-first home screen with WoW Forever artwork, built for handhelds and portrait screens alike.

## Install

Download **WoW-Foreverywhere.apk** below and open it on your device. It installs alongside the original WoW Forever app. See the [README](https://github.com/YoruDev-Ryland/WoWForeverywhere#getting-started) for setup.

## Notes

- The app downloads about half a gigabyte. On first start the game downloads the rest of its world data (about 67 GB) by itself; leave it at the login screen on Wi-Fi to speed this up.
- CurseForge and Wago Addons are not in this build yet.
- If you installed an earlier test build of this fork, uninstall it first. Earlier builds were signed with a different key, so Android won't update them in place.
